scenario: Failed upgrade forced by an adoption refusal, automatic rollback, then the previous state booting on the earlier package

packages.build: release, Packaging/install-local.sh into one isolated prefix, ad hoc virtualization signing; the develop rebuild reproduced the same binary SHA-256 as in task 5.3
packages.package_change: runtime stopped, launchctl bootout of the server job then the runtime job, removal of the server plist only, install-local.sh of develop into the same prefix, then macus start

isolation.state_dir: /tmp/macus-r53 (retained from task 5.3, on the develop root after that rollback)
isolation.incus_conf: the isolated temporary directory from task 5.3; every incus and macus start command exported it

forced_refusal.method: With the runtime ready on the develop root, one digit of pool_guid in runtime/storage-identity.json was changed (3952008500462468296 to 3952008500462468297), written atomically at mode 0600. The plan, staged upgrade seed and adoption record therefore named a GUID that no attached pool has.
forced_refusal.property_exercised: The delivered GUID is a selector, not proof: a wrong value must end in a refusal that leaves the pool untouched, never an adoption.
forced_refusal.restored_after: The real record was put back from a copy before the package change.

checks.guest_refusal: MACUS_OBSERVATION v1 stage=failed code=storage_adoption_refused; TAMA_STORAGE_REFUSED: adoption: named pool 3952008500462468297 cannot be imported from /dev/vdb1 without force; disk preserved

steps.name: start_previous_state_on_earlier_package
steps.note: The develop package ignores runtime/guest-record.json, runtime/storage-identity.json and backups/, which this change adds.

findings: The failure message appends the generic boot-failure remedy, 'Inspect serial.log, then run macus runtime stop --force and macus start', although automatic rollback has already stopped the runtime and restored the previous root. Only 'macus start' is needed.
The rolled-back backup keeps the rejected 4 GiB root under failed/ until it is pruned; nothing removes it automatically, as designed.
not_covered: A forced stop of the new root with the pool imported (task 5.6): here the pool was never imported by the new root.
A migrating failure with a data disk copy to restore.
